testing-governance.description: Section resolution, exact-input receipts, dependency freshness, process custody, and whole-certification admission gate.

dashboard-extension.description: Dashboard renderer, message boundary, host bridge, and layout interaction gate.

studio-memory-graph.description: Versioned agent/workflow/skill studios, canonical memory browsing, and progressive graph exploration.

learning-promotion.description: Evidence hashing, confidence, A/B, research, promotion, reuse, and decay gate.

execution-placement.description: Native placement package, runtime decision, boundary cost, and rollback gate.

hardware-routing.description: CPU authority, bounded accelerator discovery, routing, correctness, VRAM, benchmark, and fallback gate.

runtime-domain-contracts.description: Bounded typed source acquisition and contracts for JSON, filesystems, providers, archives, routing, registry ownership, retrieval, release projection and dependency graphs. Explicit causal test membership; final complete dependency identity remains PG-001.

process-recovery.description: Serial process custody, recovery, test-runner, WAL, resource-lifecycle, and workspace mutation tests.

exact-installed.description: Serial exact-tool, installed-wheel, corrective-release, and full-repair-ledger certification tests.

release-build.description: Serial release, distribution, artifact, and revocation certification tests excluding composed audit mutations.

release-audit.description: Serial composed-audit and quarantine-mutation tests isolated from package builds.

structural-adversarial.description: Serial full-tree structural mutation tests isolated from derived-artifact checks.

derived-integrity.description: Final serial generated-output, completion-projection, portability, effect-surface, and punch-card integrity gate.

core-a-f.description: Serial ordinary unit and contract tests whose file IDs begin A through F; this lane shares canonical registry state with core-n-s and must not overlap it.

core-g-m.description: Serial ordinary unit and contract tests whose file IDs begin G through M; this lane reads or mutates shared canonical repository state.

core-n-s.description: Serial ordinary unit and contract tests whose file IDs begin N through S; this lane reads or mutates shared canonical repository state.

core-t-z.description: Serial ordinary unit and contract tests whose file IDs begin T through Z; this lane reads or mutates shared canonical repository state.

fast.description: Correctness-critical source checks excluding expensive exhaustive and artifact-isolation gates.

full.description: Every discovered source test; new test files enter this profile automatically. The bound includes measured clean-build and adversarial full-tree mutation costs on Windows.

release.description: Full source profile plus exact tools, clean build, installed wheel, reconciliation, strict audit, and sanitization.
